name: investment-toolkit-plugins
description: Investment Toolkit plugins: AI stock valuation, portfolio advisor (health, rebalancing, strategy review), and suite orchestration.

plugins.name: stock-valuation
plugins.description: AI-driven autonomous stock valuation and research engine. Skills: /update-stock-analysis (Bear/Base/Bull DCF projections with analyticsLog), /research-stock (qualitative sweep with Class A/B/C/D change classification and decision gate before re-valuation), /forward-valuation-challenge (stress-test valuations against trailing financials), /valuation-math-validation (deterministic DCF math and spread checks).

plugins.name: portfolio-advisor
plugins.description: Investment portfolio advisor suite. Flagship /daily interactive loop. Skills: /stock-intake, /portfolio-coverage-audit, /weekly-review, /data-quality-audit, /review-portfolio, /strategic-review, /rebalance, /calibrate-targets, /update-portfolio-targets, /news-sweep, /adversarial-review, /bundle-thesis-review, /13f-tracker, /13f-analyze, /ytd-return, /set-thesis-breakers. Agents: portfolio-advisor-orchestrator, red-team-agent, risk-officer-agent.

plugins.name: etf-analysis
plugins.description: AI-driven ETF and fund analysis engine. Three fund types: CLOSED_END, THEMATIC_ETF, CASH_FUND. Trigger: /analyze-etf {TICKER}.
